verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public Sai API for driving the product from code or coding agents. It exposes concrete HTTPS endpoints (`POST /v1/agents/message`, `POST /v1/agents/approve`) with streamed approval events, plus a Python SDK and an MCP server. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), fuller endpoint reference beyond the two cited endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
